parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal with a plastic-coated tip for comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and helps maintain balance on the face.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal with a plastic-coated tip for comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and helps maintain balance on the face.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses. The lenses are made of polycarbonate, and the frame is metal.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the main structure for vision correction or sun protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the legs fold; it serves as the central rigid component of the eyeglasses.
